role: Define shared exception hierarchy for Co-Being application error handling across system layers.
detail: Defines base exception CoBeingError for uniform application error catching and GraphUnavailableError (inherits CoBeingError) for graph database connectivity failures. GraphUnavailableError carries reason (machine-friendly tag) and detail (human-readable explanation) attributes, initialized via __init__(reason: str, detail: str). Designed to provide actionable context without catch-and-inspect patterns. Covers database-layer failure modes: process down/unreachable, auth rejection, missing plugins (APOC), version mismatch. No constants, algorithms, or side effects beyond exception initialization.
gotchas: Only two exception types defined; GraphUnavailableError.__init__ calls super().__init__() with formatted message combining reason and detail. No other exception types currently in place for other failure modes (network, serialization, permission, etc.)
